name: DatePicker
title: DatePicker
summary: A text field with a calendar button inside it that opens a 352px month popover for picking a single future date.
whenToUse: Scheduling: a partner call, an event sign-up, the start of a report range.
Typed entry is always allowed; the calendar is a helper, not the only way in.
Birthdays and dates far in the past: use three plain fields (month, day, year), not a calendar.
Picking a time slot from a short fixed list: use Select or Radio.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, for example "Preferred call date".

props.name: value
props.description: Selected date (controlled). `null` is empty. Dates are local calendar days; the time is ignored.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial date (uncontrolled).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when a date is committed (Done, or valid typed text on blur) or cleared (`null`).

props.name: onInvalidText
props.description: Called on blur when the typed text cannot be read as a date. Show your own `error` in response.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for month and weekday names, field order, the long date and the first weekday.

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest selectable day. Earlier days stay in the grid but are disabled.

props.name: max
props.description: Latest selectable day.

props.name: weekStart
props.default: from the locale (Intl week info), else Sunday for US and Monday elsewhere
props.description: First weekday, 0 = Sunday to 6 = Saturday.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder for the text field.

props.name: optionalText
props.description: Tag such as "(optional)" shown after the label.

props.name: hint
props.description: Helper line under the field, linked with `aria-describedby`.

props.name: error
props.description: Error under the field. Sets `aria-invalid`.

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides for accessible names and button texts (English defaults).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Open the calendar initially (for previews and tests).

props.name: today
props.description: Treat this day as "today" (testing and previews).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the field and the calendar.

props.name: required
props.description: Mark the input required.

props.name: id
props.description: `id` of the text input. Generated when omitted.

props.name: name
props.description: `name` of the text input; the posted value is the long date text.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the outer `.field`.

variantNotes: Empty: placeholder "MM / DD / YYYY" and a `.hint` line.
Filled: the date written out in full ("Sunday, October 18, 2026"); button label becomes "Change date, October 18, 2026".
Error: `aria-invalid="true"` on the input and one `.err` line ("Choose today or a later date.").
Open: field shows the focus ring (`.fm-focus` in static specs) and the button gets `.fm-on` (`--blue-tint` fill, `--horizon-blue` icon).
Day hover: `--blue-tint`. Today: 1.5px inset `--horizon-blue` ring, `--horizon-blue-dim` text (`.fm-today`).
Disabled (past or unavailable): `disabled`, `--gray-300` text, no hover.
Previous-month arrow is disabled when the earlier month has no open dates.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Always let people type the date; parse common formats and rewrite to the long form on blur.
Disable past dates for scheduling; never hide them, so the grid keeps its shape.
Mark today with the ring and the selection with the fill; they can sit on the same day.
The popover footer holds exactly one Horizon Blue primary (Done); Cancel is `.btn-secondary`, Today is `.btn-ghost`.
Week starts on Sunday for US English; follow the locale elsewhere.
Keep every day cell and nav arrow at least 44px; never shrink the grid below 320px.
On phones, open the calendar as a bottom sheet with the same grid.

accessibility: Calendar button: `aria-label` ("Choose date" or "Change date, October 18, 2026"), `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `aria-expanded`.
Popover: `role="dialog"` with `aria-label`; month name in a polite live region.
Days: today gets `aria-current="date"`; the selected day `aria-selected="true"` and a full label ("October 18, selected").
Keys: arrows move a day / a week, PgUp / PgDn change month, Home / End go to week start / end, Enter picks, Esc closes and returns focus to the calendar button.
Errors are linked with `aria-describedby` and repeated in the form's validation summary.
content: Label: "Preferred call date". Hint: "Type a date or pick one from the calendar."
Filled value: "Sunday, October 18, 2026" (day, month and year spelled out).
Errors: "Choose today or a later date." / "Enter a date like 10 / 18 / 2026."
